target_issue: packages/pg-pool/index.js: This new runtime dependency is not included in the pg-pool published package: packages/pg-pool/package.json still restricts `files` to `index.js` and `esm`, so `diagnostics.js` would be omitted from npm tarballs and `require('./diagnostics')` would fail for consumers. The package files list needs to include this module (or the code needs to live in an already included file).
